name: Please Be Quiet Bergen 2023
information: **Norsk:** Denne konkurransen tar utgangspunkt i blindegrener. Konkurransen vil **IKKE** holde 3x3, for de som ønsker å delta i 3x3 kan vi anbefale å sjekke ut [Bergen Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2023). **Engelsk:** This competition mainly holds blindfolded events. The competition will **NOT** hold 3x3, for those who wish to participate in 3x3 we would like to recommend [Bergen Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2023).
